notes.scope: External neutrino audit inputs (Match/Audit only). These values do not enter any CAP selection in this paper.

channels.name: 0νββ (neutrinoless double beta decay)
channels.comment: Representative upper bound on the effective Majorana mass m_{ββ} (order-of-magnitude; depends on isotope and NME convention). Units: eV. Used as Match/Audit only.

channels.name: Cosmology (Σ mν)
channels.comment: Representative bound for ΛCDM using Planck-2018 + BAO style combinations (model dependent). Units: eV. Used as Match/Audit only.

channels.name: KATRIN (mβ)
channels.comment: Representative kinematic endpoint bound (order-of-magnitude audit). Units: eV. Used as Match/Audit only.

channels.name: Sterile / extra radiation (N_eff or ΔN_eff)
channels.comment: Representative upper bound on |ΔN_eff| as an audit-only proxy (model dependent). Used as Match/Audit only.
